g.text: D2 s44 IS MARKED UNRESOLVABLE IN EVERY ROW. F4(a) puts that pair's between-arm gap at 1.4 sampling standard deviations under 40 draws of 80% of

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #d55e00

g.text: patients, so no row of this table can score it. Effective rank's honest D2 record therefore reads: 1 clear hit, 1 clear miss, 1 pair it cannot resolve.

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #d55e00

g.text: The counts in the D2, D1 and ALL columns are the run's own, which score that cell; they are printed as the run produced them and are NOT corrected here.

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: LiDAR is ADAPTED - q = 2 with the two modalities as views, licensed by the paper's own footnote 4 but outside the authors' tested q range - and its

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: ordering is invariant across delta from 1e-8 to 1e0. alpha-ReQ follows the authors' released fastssl estimator rather than the paper text, and |alpha - 1| is

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: OUR operationalisation of their "Goldilocks zone", not theirs: all twelve artifacts sit at alpha between 2.6 and 4.8, far outside it. RankMe as published is

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: uncentred on the RAW block, per its own definition; no value in this table is compared against a PUBLISHED RankMe number.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: AND EVERY MARK ABOVE IS SCORED AGAINST ONE COORDINATE SYSTEM OUT OF SIX.

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: The ground truth is the held-out channel onto 40 GENE-SET targets. That arm contrast exists on the gene sets and on no other target block on disk (draft 4.6a). Re-scoring the same two arms on each block

text.style: font-size: 6.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: in turn flips seed 43, and with it every metric row's D2 count. The D1 half cannot be re-scored -- those arms were never scored on any block but the gene sets -- so only the D2 count moves here.
